summary: The build request explicitly rejects Firebase integration as a non-goal and constrains all data persistence to the ICP backend (Motoko actor) or localStorage. The diff shows the backend/main.mo file uses a proper ICP Motoko actor with no Firebase SDK, which aligns with the constraints. However, project_state.json still describes Firebase integration as a pending feature request and an architectural note, which directly contradicts the build request's non-goals and constraints.

hallucinated_features.description: project_state.json retains a pending feature request (AR-1) to 'Add Firebase integration for data saving' and an architectural note stating 'Firebase will be used as the backend for data persistence'.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly rejects Firebase integration as a non-goal and forbids any external cloud database services. The project state should reflect the rejection of Firebase, not its pending adoption.
